claims: The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival takes place on Saturday, March 28, 2026.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival takes place from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival takes place at the Washington Monument Grounds, 130 17th St NW, Washington, DC.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival has free admission.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival is open to the public.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival is part of the National Cherry Blossom Festival.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival features professional kite flying demonstrations.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival features competitions.
The 2026 Blossom Kite Festival features kitemaking activities for children.
The Oxon Run Pinknic & Kite Fly takes place on Sunday, March 29, 2026, in Ward 8.
The Oxon Run Pinknic & Kite Fly is part of the National Cherry Blossom Festival.
Attendees of the Oxon Run Pinknic & Kite Fly are encouraged to bring their own kites or build one at the event to participate in the festivities.
